items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Trumbauer used to come over and sit in our band

ctx.x: Bix and Frankie Trumbauer and all those guys---
Yeah - all those guys were with him and I always thought that the reason Bix - and Trumbauer used to come over and sit in our band, that he didn't get

enough playing in that big band-- he didn't get to play enough jazz in that band; although they had jazz arrangements and good arrangements, I don't think he and Trumbauer got enough playing in it. They used to come over and play in our band because we went to six in the morning, you know. And, so, -- oh, now the time is drawing near when we're suppose to join Nebauer's band - and, so, I -- the boss had taken me out; I had met Miss Detroit at that time---
